representation.rationale: Widens the proven residual_cnn from hidden=32 to 48 at the same depth=3, with a small dropout bump to 0.25 to regularize the extra parameters. All other hyperparameters (adamw, cosine, lr=3e-4, wd=1e-4, class_weighting, label_smoothing=0.05, hflip+vflip, standardize) are held at the round-1 optimum to isolate the capacity effect.

payload.selection_rule: accuracy within tolerance, then macro-F1; test locked

train_config.rationale: Selected from 4 validation-only trials. Widens the proven residual_cnn from hidden=32 to 48 at the same depth=3, with a small dropout bump to 0.25 to regularize the extra parameters. All other hyperparameters (adamw, cosine, lr=3e-4, wd=1e-4, class_weighting, label_smoothing=0.05, hflip+vflip, standardize) are held at the round-1 optimum to isolate the capacity effect.
